queries.sql: SELECT p.*, r.batch_code AS raw_batch_code, r.material_name FROM production_batches p JOIN raw_material_batches r ON p.raw_batch_id = r.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT s.*, p.product_name, p.production_code, p.product_type, u.full_name AS distributor_name FROM shipments s JOIN production_batches p ON s.production_batch_id = p.id JOIN users u ON s.distributor_id = u.id WHERE s.distributor_id = '5' ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
